user.title: HVAC Zone Manager
user.description: Global settings. One entry manages one direction: make a Cooling entry and, separately, a Heating entry over the same rooms. You can change the numbers later from the entities this integration creates.

data.name: Name
data.max_zones: Maximum zones running at the same time
data.max_run_minutes: Max zone run time in minutes, 0 = no limit (a zone running this long is rotated out if other zones are waiting)
data.cooldown_minutes: Compressor cooldown in minutes, 0 = off (once every zone is off, no zone may start again until this much time has passed)
data.temp_sensor: Outdoor temperature sensor (optional, cooling only — lets the outdoor temperature limit how many zones may run at once)
data.mode: Mode — cooling caps how many zones run at once; heating adds a floor (Min zones) so one zone never runs alone

zone.title: Add a zone
zone.description: Zones added so far: {zone_count}. Each zone needs the entity that signals demand (the request) and the entity that actually runs the equipment. For heating, also pick the zone's thermostat: it decides which zone joins as a companion and when it gives back.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. bedrooms)
data.switch_entity: Zone switch (what gets turned on and off)
data.add_another: Add another zone after this one

error.duplicate_name: A zone with this name was already added.
error.duplicate_switch: This zone switch is already used by another zone.
error.same_entity: The request entity and the zone switch must be different entities.

temp_sensor.title: Outdoor temperature sensor
temp_sensor.description: Pick a sensor to let the outdoor temperature limit how many zones may run at once, or clear the field to turn the feature off. The change applies immediately.

add_zone.title: Add a zone
add_zone.description: Current zones: {zone_count}. The new zone joins the rotation immediately.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. bedrooms)
data.switch_entity: Zone switch (what gets turned on and off)
data.add_another: Add another zone after this one

remove_zone.title: Remove zones
remove_zone.description: Removed zones are switched off if they are currently running. At least one zone must remain.

error.duplicate_switch: This zone switch is already used by another zone.
error.same_entity: The request entity and the zone switch must be different entities.
error.no_zones_selected: Select at least one zone to remove.
error.keep_one_zone: At least one zone must remain.
